question: Srimanta Sankardeva received recognition for which dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sattriya.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sattriya Dance **has its origin in the **‘Sattras’ established by Mahapurush Srimanta Sankardev** in the **15th and 16th centuries. **
 
• The Sattras were established for the propagation of Vaishnavism and later became the religious, cultural and social hub of Assam.
 
• The Sattriya dance can be classified into** two styles**, namely** ‘Paurashik Bhangi’ i.e. Tandava or Masculine style** and** ‘Stri Bhangi’ i.e. Lashya or feminine style.**
 
• On November 15 in the year **2000**, the **Sangeet Natak Akademi of India recognized Sattriya as one of the eight classical dances of India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mahapurush Srimanta Sankardev **was a great** Vaishnavite saint** and reformer born in **Alipukhuri, Nagaon, Assam** in **1449**.
 
• He was a saint, scholar, playwright, social and religious reformer is a colossal figure in the cultural and religious history of Assam.
 
• **‘Ek Sarania Nam Dharma’ **preached by him believed in the worship of Lord Vishnu.
 
• His major literacy creations are the** ‘Kirtan Ghosa’**, ‘**Gunamala’** etc. The holy songs written by him are known as ‘**Borgeet’**
 
• The** dramas** written by him are known as** ‘Ankia Naat’** and **Sattriya Dance at that time was a part of it.**
